title: Coastal Current Charters
specs: Fish species include black sea bass, fluke, striped bass, bluefish, sharks, tuna, and other pelagic species
Boat is a 2023 Everglades 235 Center Console with modern Garmin electronics
Sightseeing includes Newport Mansions, historic lighthouses, seals, seabirds, and marine wildlife
Non-marking shoes required; boat shoes or soft-soled footwear preferred; no work boots, hiking boots, studded or hard-soled shoes
Guests responsible for dressing appropriately for ocean conditions
Private charters accommodate up to six passengers excluding crew
includes: Premium tackle selected for targeted species
Guide and hands-on instruction by Captain Martin
blurb: Coastal Current Charters offers private sightseeing cruises and various fishing charters including black sea bass, fluke, striped bass, shark, and tuna fishing. Trips are customized to guest interests and current conditions, departing from Bristol, Rhode Island with pickups in Newport, Jamestown, and Prudence Island. The boat is a 2023 Everglades 235 Center Console equipped with premium tackle and modern marine electronics.
extraNote: $200 deposit required at booking; balance due prior to departure · Cancellations more than 72 hours before departure receive full deposit refund; within 72 hours forfeit deposit · Trips subject to weather, sea conditions, and captain discretion · Alcohol permitted in moderation; no glass containers; smoking prohibited onboard · Late arrivals may reduce trip time without refund · Pickup locations include Bristol, Newport, Jamestown, and Prudence Island.
